title: 第二十章 晚餐第二十一章 逮捕
slug: 我都成超人了灵气才复苏
content_zh:
晚上，七点半。
陈洛一家五口，以及弟弟的同学李峰，便分别在餐桌周围就坐。
“你叫李峰是吧，阿姨叫你小峰不介意吧？”
“你跟我家陈星是在一个班吗？”
“你学习成绩这么好？陈星你看看人家，哪像你似的，一天天吊儿郎当没个正形。”
“洛洛你别笑，你看看人家高中生身体多壮实，再看看你那弱不禁风的样子。”
餐桌上，众人除了偶尔聊些家常话外，倒也没有忘记李峰的存在。
陈父与陈母不时开口，询问着陈星这位同学的情况。
陈洛与陈星。
则不幸沦为了“自己家的孩子。
渐渐地。
李峰从最初的拘谨，逐渐转为放松。
“小峰啊，你看着壮实，是平时经常锻炼吗？”
又来了。
吃饭到一半，听母亲说到锻炼两个字。
陈洛与陈星两兄弟对视一眼，眼中皆是无奈。
或许是源自老一辈的审美。
母亲李慧珍，总觉得男人就应该壮实些，哪怕圆润些，都比瘦了吧唧的好。
因此，她没少对两兄弟唠叨。
“妈，人家从小练武的，跟咱们又不一样。”

陈星不愿在生日当天，被唠叨个没完。
他赶忙解释，顺带悄悄给陈洛使了个眼色。
“练武，是电影里那种武术吗？”
陈洛心领神会，赶忙追问。
“你们俩啊，真是...”
陈母一眼便看穿兄弟二人的心思。
但也只是无可奈何地轻叹一声，任由话题转变。
至于李峰。
面对陈洛的提问，他很快便讲起自己的情况。
据他所言。
其太爷爷，曾是一位已故武术宗师的入室弟子。
就是行过拜师礼，入了拳师谱，算得上师傅半个儿子，具备传承资格的那种弟子。
那位武术宗师的弟子后代，如今大部分都成了名人。
有的开设武馆，广收学徒，在武术界闯下名号。
有的得到夏尔联邦的官方支持，成为了传统文化的传承人。
有的进入影视行业，或是做幕后指导，或是当了武打明星。
其中有不少，都是公众耳熟能详的人物。
一听这话。
陈洛顿时被勾起浓烈的兴趣。
对方所说的这些人，不正符合他下午所推测的【突出特质＋公众认同=词条】的公式吗？

原本在他看来，只是【弟弟同学】以及【词条持有者】的李峰，赫然又多了一个标签。
【待挖掘的词条宝矿】
若能抓住这条人际关系，说不定，就能开拓一条新的词条复制通道。
想到这里。
陈洛饶有兴致地看向对方，顺着话题提问。
content_en:
In the evening, half past seven.
Chen Luo's family of five, as well as his younger brother's classmate Li Feng, sat around the dining table.
"Your name is Li Feng, right? Do you mind if Auntie calls you Xiao Feng?"
"Are you in the same class as Chen Xing and I?"
"Are you doing so well in studies? Chen Xing, look at others, how can they be like you? They are just messing around day after day without getting into shape."
"Luoluo, don't laugh. Look at how strong these high school students are, and look at how frail you are."
At the dinner table, apart from occasionally chatting about common things, everyone did not forget Li Feng's existence.
Chen's father and Chen's mother spoke from time to time, asking about Chen Xing, a classmate.
Chen Luo and Chen Xing.
Unfortunately, he became "a child of his own family."
Gradually.
Li Feng gradually changed from being cautious at first to being relaxed.
"Xiao Feng, you look strong, do you exercise regularly? "
Here we go again.
Halfway through the meal, I heard my mother mention the word exercise.
The two brothers Chen Luo and Chen Xing looked at each other with helplessness in their eyes.
Perhaps it comes from the aesthetics of the older generation.
My mother, Li Huizhen, always feels that men should be stronger, even if they are rounder, it is better than being skinny.
Therefore, she often nags the two brothers.
“Mom, people who have practiced martial arts since childhood are different from us. "
Chen Xing didn't want to be nagged endlessly on his birthday.
He hurriedly explained and secretly winked at Chen Luo.
"Martial arts training, is it the kind of martial arts in movies? "
Chen Luo understood and hurriedly asked.
"You two, you are really..."
Mother Chen could see through the two brothers' thoughts at a glance.
But he just sighed helplessly and allowed the topic to change.
As for Li Feng.
Facing Chen Luo's questions, he quickly talked about his situation.
According to him.
His great-grandfather was once a disciple of a late martial arts master.
It is the kind of disciple who has gone through the apprenticeship ceremony and entered the boxing master's book. He can be regarded as the half son of the master and has the qualifications to inherit.
Most of the descendants of that martial arts master's disciples are now celebrities.
Some opened martial arts schools, recruited apprentices, and made a name for themselves in the martial arts world.
Some have received official support from the Shire Federation and have become inheritors of traditional culture.
Some have entered the film and television industry, either as behind-the-scenes instructors or as martial arts stars.
Many of them are well-known figures to the public.
Upon hearing this.
Chen Luo was immediately intrigued.
Don’t the people the other party mentioned fit the formula of [Outstanding Characteristics + Public Recognition = Entry] that he speculated in the afternoon?
Li Feng, who originally seemed to him to be just "younger brother's classmate" and "entry holder", suddenly gained another label.
【Treasure Mine of Entries to be Discovered】
If we can seize this interpersonal relationship, maybe we can open up a new channel for copying entries.
Think of this.
Chen Luo looked at the other party with interest and asked questions along the topic.
